title: Corporate Language Model (CLM): Transforming Tacit and Fragmented Enterprise Knowledge into a Sovereign, Auditable, and Executable Corporate Intelligence Layer
abstract: arXiv:2609.04377v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Enterprise AI deployments fail not from model inadequacy, but because organizations lack a structured substrate encoding how they decide, negotiate, and execute. Generic LLMs carry no firm-specific ontological priors; RAG remains brittle, with no path to executable action; static playbooks encode logic but cannot reason or adapt. This demands an architecture treating tacit-knowledge capture, ontological grounding, sovereign deployment, and auditable actuation as co-designed from the start. This paper introduces the Corporate Language Model (CLM), a framework transforming a firm's structured, unstructured, multimodal, and tacit knowledge into an ontology-grounded enterprise foundation upon which reasoning and governed execution are composed. translated_title: 企业语言模型（CLM）：将隐性且碎片化的企业知识转化为主权可控、可审计、可执行的企业智能层
translated_abstract: 企业AI部署的失败并非源于模型能力不足，而是因为组织缺乏一个能够编码其决策、谈判和执行方式的结构化基底。通用大语言模型不具备企业特有的本体先验；RAG（检索增强生成）依然脆弱，且缺乏通往可执行动作的路径；静态操作手册虽然编码了逻辑，却无法推理或适应变化。这要求一种将隐性知识捕获、本体基础、主权部署和可审计执行从一开始就协同设计的架构。本文提出了企业语言模型（CLM），这是一个将企业的结构化、非结构化、多模态和隐性知识转化为以本体为基础的企业基座的框架，推理和受治理的执行在该基座之上构建。CLM具有五个能力平面和四大架构支柱：将生成模型与知识图谱耦合的神经符号网格；一个存储可复用策略、角色画像、异议处理等要素的技能图谱……
tldr: 本文提出企业语言模型（CLM）框架，通过本体基础、神经符号网格和技能图谱等协同设计的架构，将企业隐性碎片化知识转化为可主权部署、可审计且可执行的企业智能层。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Corporate Language Model (CLM), a framework that transforms tacit and fragmented enterprise knowledge into a sovereign, auditable, and executable corporate intelligence layer through co-designed architectures including ontological grounding, a Neurosymbolic Mesh, and a Skill Graph.
